INSERT INTO SF_NOTIFICATION (NOTIFICATION_ID, MEMBER_ID, TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, INCIDENT_ID) VALUES (#{notificationId}, #{memberId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{incidentId,jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.select: SELECT NOTIFICATION_ID, MEMBER_ID, TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, INCIDENT_ID, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT NOTIFICATION_ID, MEMBER_ID, TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, INCIDENT_ID, CREATED_AT FROM SF_NOTIFICATION WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 30
